newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh cent bank reserves $1.28 billion on March 1.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh cent bank reserves $1.28 billion on March 1.

text.p: Kazakhstan's net reserves of hard currency and gold rose to 96.9 billion tenge ($1.28 billion) from 92.5 billion tenge on February 1, the National Bank said on Friday.
Net reserves on March 1 last year were $1.22 billion.

At the start of this year the reserves of the Central Asian state were 101.9 billion tenge. Foreign reserves were boosted sharply last December after the National Bank bought hard currency from the finance ministry following its successful $200 million debut Eurobond.
